## What's in v0.1.19

This is a polish release that closes the four follow-ups from the
v0.1.18 lab pass. No schema changes, no migrations — image swap only.

### Bug fixes

- **Rollback now keeps state files in sync.** After clicking "Roll back
  last update", the recorded version (shown in the sidebar and on the
  Updates page) used to keep claiming the *post-update* version even
  though the *pre-update* images were restored. The portal will now
  report the version that's actually running.

- **Air-gap install progress no longer overshoots.** During an install
  from a `.adcupdate` bundle, the progress counter occasionally flashed
  a higher current value than total (e.g. "8 / 4") for one tick before
  settling. The counter now tracks the number of image tars in the
  bundle for the load phase, and the per-updated-service count for the
  pull / recreate phases.

### UX polish

- **Sidebar "update available" chip auto-clears after install.** When
  an install reaches Complete, the chip and Dashboard tile now refresh
  themselves within a few seconds — no more manual Refresh click on
  the Updates page just to clear a stale notification.

- **Upload-progress line clears when the confirm modal opens.** After
  uploading a `.adcupdate` file, the "Uploading … 100%" status line
  used to linger behind the install-confirmation dialog. It now goes
  away as soon as the upload finishes, leaving a clean confirm view.

### Upgrade notes

- Existing installs running v0.1.18 (or earlier) can upgrade in place
  via the Updates page.
- No backup is required: this release does not touch stateful services
  (database, MQTT broker, Redis, SFTP). The standard image swap is
  reversible via the "Roll back last update" button if needed.

# v0.1.15 — Cosmetic hotfix: drop duplicate "v" prefix on Updates page

Tiny hotfix for a UI typo. The Selected release card title and several install confirm dialogs on System → Updates were rendering `vv0.1.13` (two `v`s) because the version string already includes the `v` prefix from the catalog. v0.1.15 strips the duplicate.

## Affected text

- Selected release card title (`Selected release · v0.1.15`)
- Install confirm modal title (`Install v0.1.15?` / `Install v0.1.15 from file?`)
- "What's in v0.1.15" details panel inside the install confirm
- Hotfix / air-gap / catalog install success messages
- Downloaded release-notes filename (`aidatacollect-v0.1.15-release-notes.txt`)

No backend changes — portal-only.

## What's new

- **Updates page reshuffle.** The Selected release card with its release notes is now the first thing you see, right under the catalog status hero. Less scrolling to find "what would I be installing if I click Install all?"

- **Beta channel folded into Selected release.** The standalone Release channel card is gone — beta is now a small inline toggle at the bottom of the Selected release card ("Channel: [beta + release / release only]"). Same functionality, less screen real estate.

- **Per-service digest table collapsed by default.** The Installed images table is now hidden behind a "Show per-service digest details" expander. Most operators don't need to see digests during a normal upgrade; expanding stays one click away for debugging and support cases.

- **Release notes preview in the install confirm dialog.** When you click **Install all**, the confirmation now shows a "What's in vX.Y.Z" snippet of the release notes inside the dialog itself — so you can't accidentally install something without seeing at least the headline of what's changing. Full notes remain visible on the page above.

- **Softer empty-state copy.** Per-service rows where the catalog has no matching entry (typically a known naming difference like `ingest-worker` vs `mqtt-ingest`) now render as `—` with a tooltip instead of an alarming "NO REMOTE INFO" label.

## Upgrade notes

No configuration changes. Purely a UI refresh — install/rollback/restore logic is unchanged from v0.1.12.

<details>
<summary>Technical changelog</summary>

- **portal** `564b028` — SystemUpdatesPage reorders cards (Selected release first), folds the beta toggle into the Selected release card, wraps the Installed images table in `<details>` for collapse-by-default, softens "NO REMOTE INFO" with a tooltip. New `releaseNotesSnippet()` plain-text helper feeds the Install confirm modal's `details` slot with the first paragraph of `release_notes_md`. Selected release card now also handles the no-release-selected case so the inline beta toggle stays reachable.
- No api / backend / schema changes.

</details>

## What's new

- **Smoother install confirmation dialogs.** When you click **Install all**, **Roll back**, or other update actions, the confirmation now appears as a styled dialog that matches the rest of the portal instead of the browser's default popup. This works the same regardless of your browser's dialog settings, and looks better in dark mode and on mobile.

- **Clearer per-action wording.** Each dialog now distinguishes between safe operations (regular install with backup) and riskier ones (skipping backup on stateful services, installing prerelease hotfixes) with color-coded buttons and an icon — warning amber for normal installs, danger red for actions that bypass safety nets.

- **Keyboard-friendly.** Press **Esc** to cancel or **Enter** to confirm — same as before, just on a properly themed dialog.

## Upgrade notes

No configuration changes. The change is purely how the confirmation dialogs render — the underlying install/rollback/restore logic is unchanged from v0.1.11.

<details>
<summary>Technical changelog</summary>

- **portal** `0e3ef34` — New `<ConfirmModal>` + `<ConfirmProvider>` + `useConfirm()` hook (`src/components/shared/ConfirmModal.tsx`). Replaces 5 `window.confirm()` calls in `SystemUpdatesPage.tsx` with an awaitable styled modal supporting `warning`/`danger`/`neutral` variants, optional details panel, keyboard accessibility (Esc/Enter), and click-outside-to-cancel.
- App root wraps routes in `<ConfirmProvider>` so any page can `useConfirm()` without per-page setup.
- No api / backend / schema changes.

</details>

Companion catalog release for the v0.1.7 app tags. Triggers
publish-update-catalog.yml to build the signed catalog + .adcupdate bundle.

## Catastrophic fixes (v10.16-A class)
- `scripts/update.sh` now honors the source-override compose file on the catalog path too (previously skipped only for catalog) and rewrites `.env`'s `IMAGE_TAG` to the installed `RELEASE_VERSION` before `record-versions.sh` runs. Without these two, every customer's first in-portal Install left `installed-versions.json` with `release_version: "develop"` and the catalog selector returned `no_compatible_release` on every subsequent check.

## App-side companions (see per-repo releases)
- api v0.1.7 — catalog `trigger_update` writes source-override + new_image; image-baked `/app/VERSION`; new `/system/updates-summary`.
- portal v0.1.7 — sidebar update chip + dashboard toast; per-Card error boundary; post-wizard catalog refresh.
- ingest / dbwriter / ftpingest v0.1.7 — no-op tag bumps for catalog coherence.

## Lab verification (pending — operator-driven)
1. Factory-reset 192.168.10.30.
2. Install v0.1.6 first to mimic a paying-customer state.
3. Click Install all.
4. Confirm `installed-versions.json` ends with `release_version: "v0.1.7"`, next refresh returns `up_to_date`, and `/app/VERSION` inside adc-api reads `v0.1.7`.

v0.1.6 closes two errors that v0.1.5 lab verification surfaced post-wizard.

**api `0c06fe7` develop**:
- **#22** alerts.py:ensure_tables() ran CREATE TABLE / CREATE INDEX / ALTER TABLE on every /alerts/* request with zero locking. When the portal swapped to the dashboard right after wizard finalize, concurrent /alerts/?... and /alerts/hourly?... requests raced on pg_class_relname_nsp_index → transient 500s. Same class of race v0.1.3 closed for main schema-init via pg_advisory_xact_lock. Hoisted alerts DDL into _run_migrations; alerts.py:ensure_tables stays as idempotent defense-in-depth.
- **#23** cdp_v2_reprobe selected c.device_model — column was never defined in any schema. The error was masked pre-v0.1.5 by the camera_credentials UndefinedTableError on the same JOIN; v0.1.5 closed the table error, exposing this dead column reference. Dropped from query.

Other repos: no-op tag bumps. Recommended for every v0.1.5 install.

v0.1.5 ships an api schema-init hotfix + a Dashboard polish revert.

**api `028871a` develop** — closes three classes of fresh-install errors:
- **#20** `camera_credentials` hoisted from `discovery.py:ensure_credentials_table()` into `_run_migrations()`. Heartbeat + cdp_v2_reprobe JOIN this table on first tick (10s post-startup); previously errored UndefinedTableError until the first `/discovery/credentials` request landed.
- **#18** `cameras.trashed_at` (+ `cred_id`, `config_status`) hoisted from `cameras.py:ensure_cameras_table()` into `_run_migrations()`. Rollup services (occupancy/dwell/queue/vault_access/atm_loiter) filter `WHERE c.trashed_at IS NULL` on first tick; previously errored UndefinedColumnError until first `/cameras` request.
- **#19** `system_id` mint switched to atomic `O_CREAT|O_EXCL` — closes a cross-worker race that logged false-alarm ERROR on every first boot.

Also adds INFO start/end logging in `_run_migrations()` and a unit test guarding the hoisted DDL.

**portal `52a846d` develop** — temporary removal of the Dashboard Updates tile pending a coherence fix between dashboard cached `/system/version` and Updates page fresh `remote_catalog` state (Bug #8).

**ingest / dbwriter / ftpingest** — no-op tag bumps to keep the stack catalog in lockstep.

Recommended for every v0.1.3 install. Same compatibility envelope (`from: v0.1.0`).

v0.1.3 closes the v0.1.2 transient race window.

v0.1.2 used `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock` + early return for the migration loser worker, but that loser then started its background services BEFORE the winner's migration transaction committed — producing a ~5s window of transient `UndefinedTable` errors in service logs + a single HTTP 500 on the first dashboard load.

**Fix (api `d330fbf` develop)**: switch to blocking `pg_advisory_xact_lock`. Loser waits for winner's COMMIT (which releases the xact-lock) before proceeding. By the time it starts services, schema is committed and visible. No more transient first-tick window.

Other repos in this release are no-op tag bumps. Recommended for any v0.1.2 fresh install that observed transient errors at boot. Same compatibility envelope as v0.1.2 (`from: v0.1.0`).

v0.1.2 hotfix release. Critical schema-init race fix plus 4 other install-path bugs caught in v0.1.1 lab smoke.

**Fixes:**
- **(#16, CRITICAL)** `aidatacollect-api`: schema-init race. Two uvicorn workers concurrently called `create_hypertable`, colliding on `pg_type_typname_nsp_index` and leaving the schema half-applied (missing tables: sites, zone_display_names; missing column: mqtt_transport). Fix: serialize `_run_migrations` with `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock` + eager base-table creates + per-statement SAVEPOINTs.
- **(#17)** install-history.json chmod 0644 → 0666 so the api container can write the trial anti-cheat anchor on /setup/finalize.
- **(#13)** first-run.sh writes /etc/sysctl.d/99-aidatacollect-reserved-ports.conf reserving SFTPGo passive 60000-60010 from the kernel ephemeral pool (32768-60999) so `docker compose up` never races a transient ephemeral source port.
- **(#14)** install.sh + first-run.sh recovery panels print copy-pastable absolute paths + remind about `newgrp docker`.
- **(#15)** first-run.sh auto re-execs under `sg docker -c` when the user is in the docker group but the shell session predates the group add.
